capture.final_message:
Use standard facts about subtype and product topologies.

- For the first conjunct, characterize the image of an open set under `Subtype.coind f p hp` as the preimage under `Subtype.val` of its image under `f`. Since `f` is an open map and `Subtype.val` is continuous, this set is open in the subtype. No openness assumption on `p` is needed.

- Both sides of the `Iff` are independently true:
  - If `s` is open in `X`, the inclusion `s ↪ X` is an open map; hence the image of any open `t ⊆ s` is open in `X`.
  - Coordinate evaluation on a product is continuous by the defining product topology, so it is continuous at every point.

Thus organize the proof around the standard lemmas for codrestricting an open map, the open subtype inclusion, and continuity of product projections. Construct the equivalence by proving each universal assertion directly; there is no substantive implication between them.
